reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) discusses magnetocaloric effects in unrelated materials and provides no support for any of the key premises regarding oxidation behavior, oxide scale evolution, or elemental diffusion in the Al0.2Co1.5CrFeNi1.5Ti0.3 HEA.
premises: Selective oxidation of Al and Cr forms a protective Al2O3/Cr2O3 scale on the HEA.
Ti migration to the oxide-metal interface leads to formation of non-protective TiO2.
TiO2 formation disrupts scale integrity and accelerates degradation.
Under reducing conditions, lack of protective scale leads to internal oxidation.
